title: Weak-equivalence spans give a Bergner path object for a chunk
statement:
Use combinatorial simplicial model categories and their model cofibrations, fibrations and weak equivalences as in [lem-coef-simplicial-projective-model-calculus], full chunks as in [lem-coef-simplicial-small-chunks], and the Bergner model structure on simplicial categories as in [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison]. Let $\mathcal A$ be a combinatorial simplicial model category and $U\subseteq\mathcal A$ a full chunk. Set $U^{cf}=U\cap\mathcal A^{cf}$. Enlarge the ambient universe to contain every displayed category. Define a simplicial category $P(U)$ whose objects are triples $Z,B,C\in U^{cf}$ with a fibration $(p,q):Z\to B\times C$ such that $p$ and $q$ are weak equivalences. Its mapping simplicial set from $(Z\xrightarrow{(p,q)}B\times C)$ to $(Z'\xrightarrow{(p',q')}B'\times C')$ is the simplicial set of triples $(a,b,c)$ in $\underline{\operatorname{Map}}_{\mathcal A}(Z,Z')\times\underline{\operatorname{Map}}_{\mathcal A}(B,B')\times\underline{\operatorname{Map}}_{\mathcal A}(C,C')$ satisfying $p'a=bp$ and $q'a=cq$; composition and identities are componentwise. Write $\pi_0,\pi_1:P(U)\to U^{cf}$ for the functors selecting $B,C$ respectively.

The enriched functorial chunk factorization of $\Delta_B:B\to B\times B$ as a trivial cofibration $B\to Z_B$ followed by a fibration defines $\tau:U^{cf}\to P(U)$. These functors satisfy $\pi_0\tau=\pi_1\tau=1_{U^{cf}}$, the functor $\tau$ is a Dwyer--Kan equivalence, and $(\pi_0,\pi_1):P(U)\to U^{cf}\times U^{cf}$ is a Bergner fibration. Thus this is a path object for $U^{cf}$ in the Bergner model category: a factorization of its diagonal as a weak equivalence followed by a fibration. No cofibrancy of $U^{cf}$ is assumed.
